units.source_text: 古人说：‘世事不如意，根源在自心。’

en.t: The ancients said, 'When worldly affairs go against one's wishes, the root lies in one's own heart.'

units.source_text: 可知古昔也有像我这样的事例。

en.t: So it seems that even in ancient times there were cases like mine.

units.source_text: 但不知道我的魂魄飞向何方耳。”

en.t: Only, I do not know where my spirit has flown."

units.source_text: 其信甚长，但侍女们不便尽读。

en.t: The letter was very long, but the ladies-in-waiting could not conveniently read it all.

units.source_text: 照这语气看来，这信不像是一般定情后次日的慰问书，然而究竟怎样，不得而知。

en.t: Judging from its tone, the letter did not seem like the usual note of concern sent the day after a lovers' pledge, but what had really happened could not be known.

units.source_text: 众侍女看见公主神色大变，都很担心。

en.t: When the ladies-in-waiting saw the princess's expression change so drastically, they were all very worried.

units.source_text: 她们想道：“两人的关系究竟怎样呢？

en.t: They wondered, "What exactly is the relationship between those two?

units.source_text: 多年以来，夕雾大将竭诚照拂，无论何事都很关心，真是一个好人。

en.t: For many years, General Yugiri has looked after her with complete sincerity, showing concern in every matter; he truly is a good man.

units.source_text: 但倘把他当作夫婿，似乎反而逊色了。

en.t: But if one thinks of him as a husband, he somehow seems less impressive.
It really makes one feel very uneasy."

units.source_text: 凡亲近公主的侍女，都替她担忧。

en.t: All the ladies-in-waiting who served close to the princess worried on her behalf.
